# SANDY D. CARTER

Official website: https://watches.sandydcarter.com/

SANDY D. CARTER is an emerging accessible premium lifestyle watch brand inspired by Amsterdam and European design aesthetics. The brand is developed and marketed by House Of Brands Fashion LLP, India.

The design philosophy combines European minimalism, Dutch design inspiration, understated sophistication and timeless styling. Sandy and Carter are fictional creative personalities representing imagination and design precision; they are not founders, employees or real-world designers.

The planned collection focuses on contemporary quartz analogue watches for men and women. The planned India debut is December 2026. Intended price positioning is approximately INR 4,000–10,000; final model prices, specifications and availability will be published only when verified.

Amsterdam and the Netherlands are sources of design inspiration. The brand does not claim Dutch manufacture, an Amsterdam headquarters, Swiss manufacture or an official partnership with a Dutch design company.
